entries.speaker: narrator
entries.text: Kia ora! Welcome to Ace Runs!
entries.tts: Kia ora! Welcome to Ace Runs!

entries.speaker: narrator
entries.text: Kia ora, friend! Ready for a healthy adventure?
entries.tts: Kia ora, friend! Ready for a healthy adventure?

entries.speaker: narrator
entries.text: The indoor playground! Soft play, ball pits and slides!
entries.tts: The indoor playground! Soft play, ball pits and slides!

entries.speaker: narrator
entries.text: The arcade! Glowing games, claw machines and prizes!
entries.tts: The arcade! Glowing games, claw machines and prizes!

entries.speaker: narrator
entries.text: The outdoor playground! Swings, see-saws and the roundabout!

entries.speaker: narrator
entries.text: The sports park! Rugby, netball, cricket and heaps more!

entries.speaker: narrator
entries.text: The jungle! Swinging monkeys, ambling elephants and hopping frogs!

entries.speaker: narrator
entries.text: The parks and gardens! Let's run through all four seasons!
